name: Context7
summary: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code snippets for software libraries, ranked for a question; plus reading one web page narrowed to a question.

api_key.description: A Context7 API key (context7.com/dashboard; starts with ctx7sk). Optional: search and docs work anonymously at low rate limits; a key raises them and reaches private libraries.

notes: Library ids are URL paths: /owner/repo for GitHub (/vercel/next.js), /<source>/<id> otherwise; pin a version with /owner/repo/<version> or /owner/repo@<version>.
Typical flow: libs.search to find the id, then docs.context with it; or docs.search in one call when the library is known by name.
Answers are plain text by default; send type=json for structured results.
Over the limit answers 429 with Retry-After and RateLimit-Limit/-Remaining/-Reset headers; usage.get shows the month's requests.

endpoints.name: Find a library by name
endpoints.summary: Context7 libraries matching a name, ranked against the question you are trying to answer.

query.description: The user's question or task, used for ranking.

fast.description: true skips LLM reranking for lower latency. Default false.

endpoints.name: Get documentation for a library
endpoints.summary: The snippets and doc sections of one library most relevant to a question, reranked.

libraryId.description: Context7 library id, optionally with a version.

query.description: The question or task, up to 500 characters.

language.description: Programming language to rank first, e.g. Python; a soft preference.

notes: A version that is not indexed is not an error: the nearest matching or newer stable release is served instead.

endpoints.name: Search documentation in one call
endpoints.summary: Picks up to four relevant libraries for a question, fetches and reranks their docs, and returns one answer-sized result.

query.description: The question or task, up to 2000 characters; pasted error output is fine.

library.description: Up to four library hints, repeated: a name like next.js or an id like /vercel/next.js.

version.description: Version preference such as 15 or v2.3.1, or latest.

context.description: broad appends up to ~3,500 more tokens of the best pages.

endpoints.name: Read a web page, optionally only the parts answering a question
endpoints.summary: A public page rendered to Markdown, whole in token-sized slices or narrowed to the sections that answer a question.

url.description: Public http(s) URL; local and private addresses are refused.

query.description: Question to narrow the page to.

tokens.description: 100 to 10000. With query, caps the sections (default 1000); without, the slice size (default 5000).

offset.description: Character offset when query is absent; send nextOffset from the previous answer.

notes: With query, a page that does not answer it returns 404 no_relevant_content: try another page.

endpoints.name: Get API usage
endpoints.summary: This month's requests for the key's member and the teamspace, extra-request cost and daily counts.

days.description: Days of daily history, 1 to 90, default 30 (free plans at most 10).

notes: Needs an API key. Calls to it are not counted.
